name: Michael Allawos
office: City of Glendora, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Michael Allawos is the Mayor Pro Tem and District 1 representative on the Glendora City Council, elected in 2017. He is the president and CEO of Allawos & Company, a business consulting firm, and previously founded manufacturing and software companies and was a founding principal of a bank.

sentences.text: Michael Allawos is the Mayor Pro Tem and District 1 representative on the Glendora City Council, elected in 2017.
He is the president and CEO of Allawos & Company, a business consulting firm, and previously founded manufacturing and software companies and was a founding principal of a bank.

items.text: In his 2017 campaign, he opposed high-density housing and supported height limits on new buildings. In a 2026 questionnaire, he proposed reforming the California Environmental Quality Act to reduce housing costs and using artificial intelligence to cut city expenses. His campaign says he supports police and fire services. He has served as Glendora's mayor. He represents the city on the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments Capital Projects and Construction Committee.
